evidence.orientation: inferred: JASPAR MA0139 best hits inside CTCF-only ENCODE elements; convergent = the domain's upstream boundary carries a + site and its downstream boundary a - site (Rao et al. 2014)
evidence.measured: experimental: 4D Nucleome boundary calls (insulation score) on released GRCh38 Hi-C and Micro-C
evidence.controls: uniform random positions (the comparison's own control); strand labels shuffled among elements with a site, positions and presence kept
